newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish 10-year spread over bund at record low 79.
newsitem.headline: Spanish 10-year spread over bund at record low 79.

text.p: The Spanish 10-year yield spread over Bunds set a record low on Friday at 79 basis points, dealers said.
Although bonos were losing ground, erasing initial gains ahead of the week-end, the Spanish market was outperforming falling Bunds.
The previous record low was set on Wednesday at 80 basis points, down from the 85 bps set at the end of January.
The long bond future was trading at 116.10, almost unchanged from Wednesday's close at 116.09.
During the morning it hit a high at 116.31.
Earlier this morning the Bank of Spain cut its key money market rate by 25 basis points to 5.25 percent.
